column4: directive
Preserve public and protected interfaces signatures annotations and externally visible event behavior until independent contract proof.
Inventory every selected Java file before inference and bind checkpoint coverage to current source SHA-256.
Atomize independent Java leaves into private methods only when observable contracts are preserved; parallelize leaves not promotion.
Treat all non-attributed call sites as typed residue; obtain compiler-resolved call graphs before asserting effects or safe substitutions.
Require diff then linter then compiler then tests then optional runtime with M3 canon packet evidence before promotion.
Bounded may-flow CFG and compiler-symbol local reaching definitions are advisory; incomplete masks preserve switch finally expression heap exception and nested residue.
Compiler-resolved static call targets and types are guidance only; reject missing dependencies and never claim virtual dispatch or effect equivalence.
Contract fingerprints and effect facts are signals only until producer semantics and host verification are authenticated.
AST branches loops exceptions writes allocations and monitors are candidate cues only; syntax masks are not a control flow graph or effect proof.
Prefer deterministic indexing recognizers and registered recipes over probabilistic code generation.
Treat interfaces annotations signatures and Javadocs as semantic memory; retain provenance and stale-document detection.
Confirm control flow effects exceptions synchronization JNI ABI and public behavior before treating atoms as equivalent.
Never promote a pattern from a similarity pair or non-attributed effect mask; require compiler and canonical host proof at its owning scope.
Verify per-file SHA-256 and reject stale canonical source and atom checkpoint receipts.
LLM emits only one schema-bound applicable allowlisted recipe nomination and never code commands paths or authority.
Normalized logic SHA-256 groups candidate operations but does not establish semantic or behavioral equivalence.
Mask strings comments and documentation before applying regex cues; only AST or masked recognition may authorize structural evidence.
Rank exact logic cues then exact AST shapes then near SimHash; inspect syntactic contract mismatches and retain typed residue for review.
Operator catalogue matches are source-bound syntax hints only; ambiguous matches and unlisted operators remain typed residue and never grant rewrite authority.
Patternize after atomization using AST structure control flow effects and masked cues then typed residue and a fixed point.
Create or reuse an operator-reviewed Maven OpenRewrite recipe instead of accepting direct LLM source patches.
Prioritize unclassified and ambiguous semantic leaves before matched hints; preserve contract effects dispatch and flow proof obligations without claiming equivalence.
SimHash Hamming-near atoms are similarity candidates only; never infer equivalence from a distance threshold.
Structural SHA-256 groups code shape independently of identifiers and text; validate normalized structure at the owner.
Invoke LLM only on bounded typed unsolved semantic residue after deterministic candidate filtering.
Promote serially FILE to PACKAGE to MODULE to REACTOR to API after independent tests behavior proof and provenance sealing.
